'''Unit skills''', also called '''unit abilities''', give [[units]] special characteristics in [[combat]] or [[movement]]. A unit may have one or multiple skills. 

== List of Unit Skills ==

: ''This table lists units by skill. For a list of skills by unit, see [[List of Units]].''

|'''Convert'''''{{anchor|Convert}}{{anchor|convert}}''
|Allows a unit to convert an enemy unit into a friendly unit by attacking it.
Converted units take up population in the mind bender’s capital (except units with Independent skill). If no capital is owned, then a random city starting from the southernmost to northernmost city is chosen.

Units of the Cymanti tribe instead have the identical skill “Parasite.”
|
*[[Mind Bender]]
*[[Shaman]]

|'''Double Attack'''

|'''Drench'''
|Allows a unit to flood any tile it attacks. Units with this skill can also attack tiles without an enemy unit present.
|
* [[Puffer]]
|-
|'''Eat''' {{anchor|Eat}}{{anchor|eat}}
|Allows a unit to grow segments that move in tandem with the unit after killing units via attack (retaliation kills do not produce segments). A unit with segments attached is restricted to 1 movement and cannot enter ports (except those with algae; This is most likely due to a bug) until the segment attached to the unit is removed.
|
*[[Centipede]]
|-
|'''Escape''' {{anchor|Escape}}{{anchor|escape}}
|Allows a unit to move after attacking in the same turn. The unit cannot attack again in the same turn if they have dash.
|
*[[Rider]]

*[[Crab]]
*[[Baby Dragon]]
*[[Battle Sled]]

|'''Explode''' {{anchor|Explode}}{{anchor|explode}}
